Abstract- This work presents LABORAL, a game for hand
stretching using gestural interactions, designed for people who
perform repetitive movements using the computer. This workload
causes pain that impacts performance, resulting in occupational
diseases, such as RSI (Repetitive Strain Injury) and WMSD
(Work-Related Musculoskeletal Disorder). LABORAL was de-<
veloped in Unity, using the Leap Motion sensor. In the game, a
sequence of stretching exercises is shown and must be performed
by the player via gestural interaction with the hands, ﬁngers and
wrists. During the exercises, the hand poses must be sustained
for 10 seconds, to guarantee the effectiveness of the stretch. After
that time, a new pose is displayed on the game screen and so on.
LABORAL provides practical opportunities for players to learn
to perform some hand stretching exercises in a more engaging
way, while realizing the importance of maintaining the health of
their upper limbs, collaborating for education and the consequent
